subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

There is a spectrum / of seas around that / land which attracts / tourists of all aging.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1. **"tourists of all aging".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The phrase **"tourists of all aging"** is incorrect in this context. The issue here is with the word "**aging**."
 
• The **correct **phrase should be **"tourists of all ages."**
 
• "Ages" refers to people of all age groups, while "aging" is a process of becoming older, which does not fit logically in this sentence.
 
• Replacing "aging" with "ages" corrects the grammatical error and makes the sentence meaningful.

Therefore, the correct answer is- *There is a spectrum of seas around that land which attracts tourists of all ages.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 ("There is a spectrum"): This part of the sentence is correctly framed. It correctly introduces the idea that there is a range or variety present, in this case, referring to seas.
 
• Option 3 ("land which attracts"): This segment is correctly constructed as well. It indicates that the land attracts something, which is a proper use of attraction in a sentence.
 
• Option 4 ("of seas around that"): This phrase correctly provides additional information about the spectrum mentioned in Option 2, indicating the variety of seas surrounding a specific area.
